safety_lead_time.comparison_action: reduce SAP safety lead time from 0.0 to 1.85 recommended days

narrative: Demand for PL3__MF2AB007 is intermittent (CV=0.61), with ~20% zero-demand working days and active-day consumption clustering near 1,900 units — producing a left-skewed distribution. Lead times average just 1.05 days but are highly unstable (CV=0.89), making lead-time variance the dominant safety stock driver. An (r,Q) policy with MOQ-constrained order quantity of 22,835 units and a statistically derived safety stock of 2,582 units satisfies the 95% service level while reducing annual holding costs by 80.9% versus the current SAP baseline.

The MOQ constraint fixes Q at 22,835 units; the reorder point absorbs lead-time and demand variability through a statistically computed safety stock.
